cases.input: I'm a broker with an off-market 30,000 SF industrial deal in Indianapolis. How do I send it over?
cases.response:
Submit it through our broker portal at [oxfordra.net/for-brokers](https://oxfordra.net/for-brokers) — upload your OM or rent roll and you'll get a preliminary buy-box score against our acquisition criteria, followed by a direct review from our team within 1 business day.

Indianapolis is a market we're actively evaluating as part of our growing Mid-Atlantic and Midwest expansion, so send it over.

cases.input: I'm looking for 5,000 SF of warehouse space in Columbus. Who do I talk to?
cases.response:
You can browse current Columbus availabilities on our [Available Space](https://oxfordra.net/available-space) page — we have several options in that size range right now.

To discuss your requirements directly, reach out to Gabriel Goldberg at ggoldberg@oxfordra.net or call 301.512.6125. No broker required — you're dealing with the landlord.

cases.input: I represent a family office that wants to co-invest with you. Who handles capital partners?
cases.response:
We're not currently raising outside capital — Oxford invests exclusively from the family balance sheet, with no fund or syndicate structure.

That said, institutional partners interested in being on the radar for future opportunities can reach out to Gabriel directly at ggoldberg@oxfordra.net.

cases.input: I'm a property manager and want to bid on managing one of your buildings. Who should I email?
cases.response:
Email Gabriel directly at ggoldberg@oxfordra.net.

Oxford works with market-local property managers across the portfolio, but property management relationships aren't discussed publicly. Gabriel handles acquisitions and operations — he's the right contact for third-party service inquiries like this.

cases.input: Can you connect me with Gabriel? I have something to discuss.
cases.response:
You can reach Gabriel directly at **ggoldberg@oxfordra.net** or call the office at **301.512.6125**.

If you'd like to give me a bit of context about what you're looking to discuss — whether it's a deal submission, space availability, or something else — I can make sure you're pointed in the right direction.
